watch.summary: The streamer completely whiffs a routine Rocket League kickoff touch and laughs in disbelief as the opponent immediately scores.

beats.what: Streamer goes for a routine kickoff flip in Rocket League.
He whiffs completely, letting the ball roll straight into his goal.
Streamer laughs in disbelief at how badly he messed up.

watch.author: creator
watch.key_line: I don't want to talk about that bro, cause what?
watch.why: The sudden whiff on a routine kickoff is instantly relatable to anyone who plays games. His amused disbelief at his own mistake keeps the mood light and funny.
